title: Zoho CRM Pricing 2026: Free to Ultimate, Per-User Cost
text:
As of November 2026, Zoho CRM has a free edition for 3 users and four paid editions: Standard at $14, Professional at $23, Enterprise at $40 and Ultimate at $52 per user per month when billed yearly. Billed month to month, the same editions list at $20, $35, $50 and $65. There is a 15-day free trial with no credit card required. I run Ecommerce Paradise, and CRM pricing is one of the questions store owners ask me most once quotes, calls and follow-ups start piling up.

...

## Zoho CRM Pricing at a Glance (November 2026)

| Edition | Billed yearly (per user per month) | Billed monthly (per user per month) | What the pricing page lists |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | $0 | Leads, deals, workflows, reports and a mobile app, free for 3 users |
| Standard | $14 | $20 | Workflows and assignment rules, AI agents, cadences, reports and dashboards, sales forecasting, self service kiosks |
| Professional | $23 | $35 | Everything in Standard plus CPQ, email intelligence, process automation, widgets, inventory management, Google Ads integration |
| Enterprise (marked Most Popular) | $40 | $50 | Everything in Professional plus an AI sales assistant, journey orchestration, territory management, custom functions, wizards, customer portals |
| Ultimate | $52 | $65 | Everything in Enterprise plus enhanced feature limits, consulting, migration assistance, custom AI and ML, data preparation |

Source: the edition names and feature lists come from the Zoho CRM pricing page. One important note on the currency: my browser was geolocated outside the United States, so the live page showed Indonesian rupiah. I took the US dollar figures from the pricing data file that the page loads, and the rupiah values in that file match what the page rendered for the yearly prices, which is how I checked I was reading the right columns. I then cross-checked the same dollar figures against that data file fetched from a US connection and against Zoho’s own edition comparison PDF, and all of them matched ($14, $23, $40 and $52 billed yearly; $20, $35, $50 and $65 billed monthly). Zoho also says local taxes such as VAT and GST are charged on top, so confirm the dollar figures on your own screen before you budget.

## Yearly vs Monthly: How Much Billing Changes the Price

Zoho’s pricing page has an Annually and Monthly toggle, and the gap between them is large on the cheaper editions. Using the list prices above, here is the saving per user per month when you pay yearly. This is my own arithmetic.

| Edition | Monthly price | Yearly price | Saving per user per month | Percent saved |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | $20 | $14 | $6 | 30% |
| Professional | $35 | $23 | $12 | 34% |
| Enterprise | $50 | $40 | $10 | 20% |
| Ultimate | $65 | $52 | $13 | 20% |

The percentages are rounded to the nearest whole number. The page’s FAQ also says you are not bound by any contracts or commitments, that Zoho CRM is pay as you go, monthly or yearly, and that you can change plans whenever you need to. That makes monthly billing a reasonable way to test an edition for a quarter before locking in the yearly rate. What the page does not say is whether the yearly price is refundable if you cancel midway, so ask Zoho before you prepay for a big team.

Zoho News Catch-Up: Analytics becomes an agentic analytics platform, PRM to manage partners in CRM, AI-built projects in Projects, LLM-powered Zia Matches in Recruit, and Forms pre-filled with CRM data, plus Webinars on CRM, Sign, and Creator – InterConnecta

# Zoho News Catch-Up: Analytics becomes an agentic analytics platform, PRM to manage partners in CRM, AI-built projects in Projects, LLM-powered Zia Matches in Recruit, and Forms pre-filled with CRM data, plus Webinars on CRM, Sign, and Creator 

 November 10, 2026 

Welcome to our update, where you can keep up with the latest Zoho news all in one place!

1. Zoho Analytics makes the leap to agentic analytics with version 7.0
2. Programs, portals, and commissions for your partners: PRM arrives in Zoho CRM
3. Build projects from a document with AI and sync Zoho Projects with Analytics in real time
4. Zia Matches now uses an LLM to find better-fit candidates in Zoho Recruit
5. Public forms that fill themselves with your CRM data, thanks to Zoho Forms
6. Zoho webinars: CRM, Sign, and Creator

## Zoho Analytics makes the leap to agentic analytics with version 7.0

Zoho has launched the new Zoho Analytics, and the shift goes deep: it moves beyond being a self-service BI platform for building reports and dashboards and becomes an agentic analytics platform, where AI agents do much of the work for you.

(image via zoho)

Six agents behind one conversation

Ask Zia is now a super agent with six sub-agents covering the full analytics workflow. They all work from the same semantic layer, ontology, and conversation context, so you can start with an analysis, move on to building a pipeline, and never lose the thread.

...

What’ ... next: dynamic business context that updates automatically, decision intelligence that learns from ... outcomes of agent actions, greater openness through open standards and MCP, and a unified data platform bringing together a lakehouse, data integration, data preparation, business context, analytics, data science, and agent building.

Get the full details in the official announcement and on the What’s New page.

Availability: Zoho Analytics pricing hasn’t changed. Every plan now includes monthly Zoho LLM credits and a one-time Zoho Key System (ZKS) pool for external models, with add-on credits available; the Basic plan (2 users and 0.5 million rows) includes 10,000 credits. The new capabilities are in the cloud now and are opening up gradually across regions and users. Preview versions of pixel-perfect reporting, the ontology, and the semantic model will roll out globally over the next four to eight weeks, and the on-premise version will get these updates in Q1 2027.

## Programs, portals, and commissions for your partners: PRM arrives in Zoho CRM

Growing a partner ecosystem is a good problem to have, but what starts with a handful of partners can turn into a maze of spreadsheets, emails, and disconnected processes. How do you run several programs at once, track partner-generated opportunities, calculate commissions accurately, pay on time, and give partners visibility without adding work for your team? That’s where PRM for Zoho CRM comes in.

PRM (Partner Relationship Management) brings your entire partner ecosystem into a connected experience with Zoho CRM: one place to add partner accounts and contacts, manage programs, track partner activity and performance, reward their contribution, and scale your channel operations.

(image via zoho)

Partner programs built around your strategy: create tiered or non-tiered programs with clearly defined requirements, benefits, and performance expectations.

- Requirements: measurable targets, such as revenue generated, deals closed, or other sales outcomes, that define eligibility.
- Benefits: configure what participating partners, or partners in specific tiers, receive.
- Evaluation: use performance cycles to measure each partner against the requirements and track their progress.
- Tiers: create tiers such as Bronze, Silver, and Gold, each with its own targets and benefits, and use the results to decide on promotions or demotions.

(image via zoho)

A portal for every program: each program comes with its own partner portal, where partners can register deals and check their commissions without waiting on your team for updates.

(image via zoho)

Simpler deal registration: partners submit opportunities through the portal and your team reviews and approves them with full visibility. That reduces channel conflict, protects each partner’s contribution, and keeps a clear record of every opportunity in the pipeline.

(image via zoho)

(image via zoho)

Performance tracking: performance cycles show how each partner is progressing against your targets, so you can decide whether to promote, demote, or keep them in the program.

(image via zoho)

End-to-end commission automation: define commission plans and eligibility rules, and PRM automates calculations, discrepancies, clawbacks, and payouts. It works for commissions based on transactions or revenue milestones, so every partner is rewarded accurately and on time.

(image via zoho)

(image via zoho)

Getting started:

1. In Zoho CRM, go to App Space > PRM > Install PRM. PRM can only be enabled for organizations that have migrated to Zoho CRM’s new UI.
2. Once installed, switch between CRM and PRM from the app menu.

(image via zoho)

Learn more in Zoho’s announcement and the PRM installation guide.

Availability: for Zoho CRM Enterprise and Ultimate, Zoho CRM Plus, and Zoho One customers, at no extra charge for now. It is rolled out across all data centers. Mobile app support is coming soon.

## Build projects from a document with AI and sync Zoho Projects with Analytics in real time

Creating projects and keeping reports up to date are part of everyday project management. With the latest Zoho Projects updates, you can now create a project from a requirements document or a prompt using an AI agent, and sync project data with Zoho Analytics in real time.

Projects created with AI: for a product launch, for example, your team uploads the project brief and the agent generates a structure with product preparation, testing, marketing, and release. You can add extra instructions as prompts. Then you review the generated plan, refine the details, and choose which custom fields and modules to include before creating the project.

...

Real-time sync with Zoho Analytics: project data can now sync with Zoho Analytics instantly, in addition to daily, hourly, and weekly options. For example, a healthcare staffing agency that tracks placements as tasks in Zoho Projects and monitors staff data in Analytics dashboards can turn on Real-time Sync on the Analytics integration page: the dashboard updates across modules every time a recruiter creates or updates a request, or changes a status ... due date. Client conversations are then based on current numbers instead of the last scheduled sync.

...

More details in the Zoho Projects announcement and the guide to creating projects with AI.

Availability: AI project creation is available on all paid plans. According to the Zoho Analytics 7.0 announcement, real-time sync applies to Zoho Projects Ultimate customers on the Zoho Analytics Enterprise plan.

## Zia Matches now uses an LLM to find better-fit candidates in Zoho Recruit

...

Finding the right candidates for a job opening, or the right openings for a candidate, is central to recruiting. With Enhanced Zia Matches, powered by Zia LLM, Zoho Recruit improves that matching: the new model understands the meaning and context of candidate and job data, so the most relevant matches rank higher.

...

Availability: rolling out to all users over the coming weeks, so availability may vary as the rollout progresses. Once enabled, users with the Administrator profile can configure the Zoho Forms integration settings.

title: Zoho CRM for Everyone in 2026: A Rollout Playbook
text:
What Zoho CRM for Everyone Actually Changes

Zoho announced early access to CRM for Everyone in June 2024. That early access program has since closed and the capability is open to all customers, delivered through Zoho CRM's NextGen UI.

The idea is straightforward. Classic Zoho CRM assumes one CRM, one set of organisation-wide modules, one admin who configures everything. CRM for Everyone keeps that core intact and adds a second layer on top: dedicated spaces where individual teams get their own modules, their own permissions and their own intake channel from the rest of the business.

...

Teamspace counts are capped per edition. Standard allows 5, Professional 10, Enterprise 25 and Ultimate 25. On the Free edition users are added to teamspaces by default but cannot create new ones.

Team module counts scale much harder: Standard allows a maximum of 10, Professional 25, Enterprise 200 and Ultimate 500. Team modules are not available at all on Free. The 50 folders per teamspace limit applies across editions.

Some views are gated too. Free edition lacks chart view, timeline view, team modules, public fields and team users. Standard and Professional lack timeline view and the Interactions tab.

Then there is licensing. Team users are priced at US 9 dollars per team license per month when paid annually, or US 11 dollars per team license per month when paid monthly. One important exception in Zoho's documentation: team users are not available in Zoho One, so there is no team user license there. If you are a Zoho One shop planning to bring 40 non-sales staff into CRM as team users, verify that against your own contract before you promise it internally.

title: Zoho Rebuilds Campaigns Platform With Simpler Email and SMS, Native WhatsApp and AI Agent Workflows | Media OutReach Newswire
text:
Zoho Rebuilds Campaigns Platform With Simpler Email and SMS, Native WhatsApp and AI Agent Workflows | Media OutReach Newswire

# Zoho Rebuilds Campaigns Platform With Simpler Email and SMS, Native WhatsApp and AI Agent Workflows

Published on: 13 Nov 2026 10:10am | Issuer: Zoho Corporation

- A rebuilt email editor and redesigned workspace cut the steps to create and launch a campaign 
- Email, SMS and WhatsApp now run from a single workflow 
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) support lets compatible AI agents build, schedule and analyze campaigns 
- Paid plans still start at $4 a month, with no price increase. 

 SINGAPORE – Media OutReach Newswire – 13 November 2026 – Zoho Corporation, a global technology company, today announced a comprehensive update of Zoho Campaigns, its multichannel marketing platform. The update introduces a redesigned campaign experience, a template editor rebuilt from scratch, faster contact imports and email sends, native WhatsApp marketing, and support for AI agent workflows that can coordinate multi-step tasks through compatible AI tools. Together, these new features make everyday campaign work easier, from building an email and selecting an audience to coordinating messages across email, SMS and WhatsApp. Marketers can now create and manage campaigns with fewer steps, work with customer data across multiple channels, and use compatible AI agents to handle tasks ranging from campaign preparation to performance analysis. “Marketing tools should help marketers get campaigns out the door, not make them navigate unnecessary complexity,” said Gibu Mathew, Managing Director, Zoho APAC. “We rebuilt Zoho Campaigns to make campaign creation faster and simpler, with improved performance and unifying email, SMS and WhatsApp channels together into one experience. With Campaigns’ AI agent workflows, marketers can delegate multi-step tasks while retaining control over their campaigns and decisions, utilizing AI as a marketer’s assistant, not a replacement.” The rebuilt Zoho Campaigns platform improves the speed of key campaign operations. In Zoho internal testing, sending 100,000 emails is now up to four times faster than before, and importing 100,000 contacts is now up to five times faster. Despite these extensive updates, pricing for Zoho Campaigns remains the same, with paid plans starting at $4 a month. Additions to Zoho Campaigns include: 

- A simpler way to run multichannel campaigns 
- WhatsApp (New): Bulk campaigns using approved message templates, trigger-based messages, and WhatsApp steps inside automated workflows. 
- Email: Fewer setup steps, clear recipient counts, and streamlined A/B testing across subject line, sender and content. 
- SMS: Simplified gateway setup, including a streamlined 10DLC brand and campaign registration process for US senders. 
- Frequency capping: Limits how often a contact is messaged across all three channels, so a customer in an email campaign and an SMS campaign is not contacted twice in the same window.

...

Closer integration with CRM and other systems Zoho Campaigns strengthens connections between marketing execution, customer data and external applications. 

- Live Zoho CRM sync: Keep contact data and audience segments up to date. 
- CRM custom views: Import contacts from a specific Zoho CRM custom view directly into a mailing list without recreating the filters. 
- Campaign creation from CRM data: Create campaigns using Zoho CRM data without switching between products for every step. 
- Expanded webhooks: Send campaign data to external applications to support connected workflows. 

 These integrations help reduce manual data handling and keep marketing activity better aligned with customer information in connected systems. Pricing and availability The updated Zoho Campaigns is available now in all regions, with pricing unchanged. SMS and WhatsApp marketing capabilities are included at no additional platform charge; sending messages requires purchased credits. Zoho Campaigns continues to offer a free plan for up to 500 contacts and 2,000 emails per month. For more information, visit www.zoho.com/campaigns About Zoho Campaigns Zoho Campaigns is a multichannel marketing platform that helps businesses create, send and analyze email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns. It integrates with Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics and supports connected workflows for campaign execution and audience management. https://www.zoho.com

title: Zoho Analytics 7.0: 7 Powerful AI Agent Wins for CRM Data
text:
Most AI dashboards fail for a boring reason. Ask the model for revenue, and it has to guess which of your three definitions you meant. On October 28, 2026, Zoho shipped Zoho Analytics 7.0 and rebuilt the product around that exact problem. It is now pitched as an agentic analytics platform, with a super agent, six specialist agents, a native semantic layer and an MCP server that lets Claude and Microsoft Copilot query your data.

...

## Key takeaways

- Zoho announced Zoho Analytics 7.0 on October 28, 2026. Ask Zia now acts as a super agent that coordinates six specialist Zoho Analytics AI agents.
- The biggest change is not the agents. It is the native ontology, semantic layer and scoping, which give every agent the same business definitions.
- A Zoho Analytics MCP server, hosted or self-managed, lets outside assistants such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot work with your analytics data.
- Zoho says pricing is unchanged. Every plan now includes monthly Zoho LLM credits plus a one-time pool for external models.
- Features are rolling out gradually by region. Some previews take four to eight weeks, and the on-premise edition follows in Q1 2027.

## What Zoho Analytics 7.0 actually changed

Zoho Analytics 7.0 turns a self-service BI tool into an agentic analytics platform. Instead of building every report by hand, you ask Ask Zia a business question, and it routes the work to specialist agents that prepare data, write formulas, build charts or run models. Zoho listed two press releases about the launch on its press page dated October 28, 2026.

The release has four parts. First, a multi-agent layer led by Ask Zia. Second, a trusted business context layer made of an ontology, a semantic layer and scoping rules. Third, an MCP server, a CLI and a Claude plug-in for working outside the Zoho interface. Fourth, governance tools such as a data catalog, a sandbox, data policies and AI observability.

Zoho’s own Zoho Analytics 7.0 what’s-new page describes the product as “now an Agentic Analytics Platform.” It also lists Code Studio, Jupyter notebooks, pixel-perfect reports, scenario analysis and anomaly detection.

...

## What Zoho Analytics 7.0 costs and how long it takes

Zoho says pricing for Zoho Analytics is unchanged with this release. According to Zoho’s pricing page, every plan includes monthly Zoho LLM credits for Ask Zia and its agents, plus a one-time credit pool for external models. Add-on credits are available for heavier use. Check current plan prices with Zoho at the time of purchase, because they vary by region and billing cycle.

...

### What is new in Zoho Analytics 7.0?

Zoho Analytics 7.0 adds Ask Zia as a super agent that coordinates six specialist agents, a native ontology and semantic layer, scoping controls, and an MCP server. Zoho announced it on October 28, 2026. It also adds a data catalog, sandbox, AI observability, a CLI, a Claude plug-in and more than 30 new connectors.

### Does Zoho Analytics 7.0 cost more?

No, according to Zoho. Zoho says pricing is unchanged, and every plan now includes monthly Zoho LLM credits for Ask Zia and its agents. Plans also include a one-time credit pool for external models, with add-on credits for heavier use. Confirm current plan prices with Zoho before you buy.

title: Zoho CRM Zia AI: Features, Updates & Use Cases in 2026
text:
## The Latest Zia AI Updates You Should Know

Zoho has pushed Zia far beyond basic keyword triggers. Here is a look at what makes Zia sharper today:

- Generative Summaries Across Channels: Zia doesn't just pull data; it can summarise lengthy email threads, support tickets, and call logs into a quick three-line cheat sheet so your reps can catch up instantly before a call.
- Deeper Predictive AI Models: The scoring models behind Zia AI lead scoring now look deeper into behavioural signals, like how fast a prospect opens an attachment or visits pricing pages, rather than just basic demographic info.
- Enhanced Natural Language Interaction: You can talk or type to Zia in plain, conversational English (or voice commands on mobile) to build reports, update records, or fetch complex records on the fly.
- Proactive Anomaly Alerts: Zia tracks your baseline metrics. If your daily lead intake drops unexpectedly or deal close rates suddenly spike, it flags the variance immediately so you can fix issues fast.

...

### Is Zia AI included in every Zoho CRM plan?

Basic Zia features are available on standard tiers, but advanced capabilities—such as predictive lead scoring, sentiment analysis, and full sales forecasting models—are primarily available on the Enterprise and Ultimate plans.
